selection_rationale: Coherent 1.5g strike fleet: two torpedo cruisers deliver saturation alpha strikes (192 rounds between them) while the battlecruiser pair provides a spinal-coiler gun line to punish anything that survives or tries to kite; corvettes screen ahead and add cheap torpedo waves. Uniform fleet speed keeps the torpedo geometry favorable - we close on our terms, saturate, and the guns finish.
formation_rationale: Lancer battlecruisers form the forward gun line at +100km, absorbing the first exchange; Darts ride ahead and wide at +130km with lateral/vertical offset to spread enemy spinal fire and screen the center. Harpoon torpedo cruisers hang back at -110km, well outside gun range, where they can launch torpedoes while the vanguard covers them; the 80km separation between the Harpoons keeps them tight enough for overlapping PD while their lateral offset complicates enemy targeting solutions.
